title: Persona Card
description: One persona card as consumed by Persona Lab. Unknown additional fields are legal and are rendered onto the card as titled sections. See docs/persona-platform/persona-card-spec.md for authoring guidance.

id.description: Unique, permanent identifier. Recommended pattern: <cat>-<dept>-<nn>, e.g. fac-che-03.

department.description: Organizational unit, spelled consistently across the bank.

category.description: Population segment for aggregate analysis (faculty, staff, student, alumni, external, ...). One word, consistent across the bank.

background.description: 2-4 sentences of career narrative, including at least one formative professional experience.

personality.description: Free-form one-line entries. Convention: temperament, communication_style, decision_style.

values.description: 3-4 ranked, person-specific values. Not generic virtues.

viewpoints.description: Stances WITH reasons, live worries, and at least one internal tension.

quirks.description: 1-2 concrete behavioral tics; keeps voices distinguishable in transcripts.

grounding.description: Tier 3 (reserved): source evidence for grounded personas.

speech_style.description: Tier 3 (reserved): observed voice description with verbatim phrases.

stances.description: Tier 3 (reserved): structured positions for pre-registered stance tracking.

relationships.description: Tier 3 (reserved): ties to other personas in the bank.

provenance.description: Tier 3 (reserved): card metadata; excluded from the rendered prompt in future engine versions.

consent.description: Required for any card modeling a real person.
